test_ConcurrentTwoPayers_NoNonceInterfer.details: Two payers (bob and carol) each sign an orderId computed from their own nonce.      Both transactions succeed with no revert, proving nonce isolation.

test_RevertFulfillOrder_AfterExpiry().details: Once the 30-minute reclaim window opens the operator can no longer fulfill.      This is the escrow deadline snapshot: fulfillment is impossible after expiry.

test_SequentialOrders_SamePayer_UniqueId.details: Demonstrates orderId uniqueness: same payer, two sequential orders each get a distinct id.

test_WitnessMismatch_DifferentBillerIdCh.details: Verifies that the witness passed to Permit2 encodes billerId, accountHash, ref.      If any of these differ at signing vs. submission, the computed witness changes      and real Permit2 would reject the signature.

failed().notice: Returns true if any test assertion has failed.

targetSenders().notice: Returns sender allowlist configured via `targetSender` (empty means no sender allowlist).
